name: Net Metering
description: Electricity generated offsets consumption directly on a 1:1 kWh basis. Excess export is banked as energy credits for future months. No cash payouts.

name: Net Accounting
description: Electricity generated offsets monthly consumption. If generation exceeds consumption, net export is purchased by CEB in cash at LKR 44.14/kWh (<=20kW). If consumption exceeds generation, net import is billed at normal domestic tariffs.

name: Net Plus
description: Total gross generation from solar PV is exported to the grid and paid in cash at LKR 44.14/kWh. Total household consumption is imported and billed separately under normal domestic tariffs.
